sql:
WITH per_tract AS (
  SELECT
    t.name AS tract_name,
    tc.n AS code_violations_2026,
    CAST(cdc.bphigh_crudeprev AS DOUBLE) * CAST(cdc.totalpopulation AS DOUBLE) / 100 AS estimated_adults_with_high_blood_pressure
  FROM fw_pg.tracts AS t
  LEFT JOIN fw_pg.tract_counts AS tc
    ON tc.geoid = t.geoid
   AND tc.run_id = 'r_20261024_e05c17'
   AND tc.source = 'm1_city'
   AND tc.grp = 'all'
  LEFT JOIN session.fw_e05c17_m2_cdc AS cdc
    ON cdc.tractfips = t.geoid
)
SELECT
  tract_name,
  code_violations_2026,
  estimated_adults_with_high_blood_pressure,
  CORR(code_violations_2026, estimated_adults_with_high_blood_pressure) OVER () AS correlation_coefficient
FROM per_tract
